headline: Google ties Search and AI together in schools
dek: Schools that block AI lose Search on student accounts, per The Verge.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: What changed
body: US schools that restrict Google's AI also lose Search on K-12 student accounts, per The Verge and SiliconANGLE.
There is no option to turn off only the AI and keep Search.

points.t: Gemini and Search are off on those accounts.
Students see a service unavailable message.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Criticism
body: Bernie Sanders called the practice extortion, per The Verge and SiliconANGLE.
Lina Khan said Google is trying to coerce schools into adopting AI (The Guardian).

items.t: The company says schools get more control.
Guided Learning is rolling out to select schools.
No answer on why Search and AI are tied.

caption.hook: Google confirmed US schools that restrict AI will also lose Search on student accounts.
body: Per The Verge and SiliconANGLE, Gemini and Search are off by default on K-12 accounts and only return if school admins turn them on. There is no option to disable only the AI. Google says search and AI are deeply integrated.

Bernie Sanders called the practice extortion and Lina Khan said the company is trying to coerce schools into adopting AI, per The Guardian. Google says it gives schools more control and points to Guided Learning, being tested in select schools.
